weeks.content:
Equation of a straight line; determination of x- and y-intercepts;
gradient of a straight line; drawing tangent to a curve at a point.

Tangent properties; perpendicularity of tangent and radius; angle
in a semicircle; angles in alternate segments.

Chord properties; angle at the centre and angle at the
circumference; cyclic quadrilaterals; properties of equal chords.

Angles in the same segment; angle in a semicircle; exterior angle
properties; solving related problems.

Sine rule and cosine rule; application to triangles; problem solving
with sine and cosine rules.

Pythagoras' theorem; applications to real-life problems; solving
2D problems involving angles of elevation and depression.

Operations with fractions; solving equations involving fractions;
application of fractions to daily life problems.
